K3 and K4 are missing entirely - there is no mention of Merko's largest-ever contracts for the Rūdninkai defence campus or new real estate development agreements in Krulli/Uus-Karlowa quarters. While the summary mentions defense contracts generally (S10, S13) and real estate resilience (S8), these do not capture the specific core material meaning required by K3 and K4. The overall coverage is strong but missing two HIGH-importance items, placing it in the 'Generally yes' category.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradiction. The narrative flows from overall performance decline to segment-specific results, order book growth, macroeconomic context, financial position, and forward-looking outlook. Explanations for revenue decline (completion of prior-year contracts) and margin stability are consistent. Comparisons between segments and years are clear. Financial metrics are presented without arithmetic contradictions. The structure progresses logically from performance results to supporting factors and outlook, maintaining internal consistency throughout.
